components.name: Switch field
components.description: Switch field — label (+ optional description) and a Switch in one tappable container; the whole row toggles. Use in settings panels and Control group. React: <SwitchField label description checked onChange size />. Sizes share field heights: S 36 (field/height/sm), M 44 (field/height/md). Props: Label, Description, Show description.

Usage
• The setting applies immediately — no Save button. If it needs Save, use Checkbox field.
• Click anywhere on the row toggles; Space toggles when focused.
• Label says what turns on ("Pointer highlight"), not an instruction ("Enable pointer highlight").
• Stack rows with 4–8 gap inside a Control group (3.20); don’t nest Switch fields in cards inside cards.
